title: Uniswap Risk Assessment
tagline: Explore the DeFi landscape with the Uniswap Risk Analysis Dashboard. Compare pools, analyze risk-return ratios, and get personalized recommendations based on your risk preference and timeframe. Dive into pool details with a click. Your DeFi decisions made easier!
description:
Navigate the DeFi space with confidence using our Uniswap Pool Analysis Dashboard. This comprehensive, web-based tool is designed to provide users with deep insights into different Uniswap and Sushiswap pools. Powered by data from TheGraph's Uniswap V2, Uniswap V3, and Sushiswap Subgraphs, the dashboard allows users to compare and analyze pools based on an array of calculated risk-return ratios, including Sortino, Sharpe, Calmar, Omega, Max Drawdown, Gain-to-Pain, and CVaRs ratios.

Users can customize their experience by selecting five predefined risk preferences and specifying their preferred timeframe. Based on these inputs, the dashboard presents the most suitable pools for investment. Want to explore a pool further? Just click on a pool to open a detailed view, complete with general pool information, all calculated ratios, and a range of charts, including return net percentage, impermanent loss, and daily volume in USD.

Whether you're a DeFi newbie or a seasoned investor, the Uniswap Pool Analysis Dashboard is your key to making informed, data-driven decisions in decentralized exchanges. Future updates aim to include real-time data, offering even more accurate and current pool performance metrics.
how_its_made:
The dashboard leverages the APIs provided by TheGraph, specifically focusing on the Uniswap V2, Uniswap V3, and Sushiswap Subgraphs to access and retrieve the necessary historical data for analysis.
The application adopts a diverse technology stack to deliver a comprehensive user experience. The front end, responsible for the user interface, is built using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. These technologies together create an interactive and visually appealing interface. The back end, which handles data processing and business logic, utilizes Flask - a lightweight web framework written in Python. This combination allows for robust and efficient handling of data operations.
